node.title: Re^2: XML access the repeating node values
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
When an XSLT query, as supported by XML::LibXML

This is incorrect, [mod://XML::LibXML] doesn't support XSLT - that would be [mod://XML::LibXSLT].

Don't use anything else today.

There are plenty of good XML processing modules, more than those two. For example, [mod://XML::Rules], [mod://XML::Compile], ...
